plugin.name: BlootReport
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Tracks all bloot tiers: per-tier on/off, stats window with keep/unkeep/report, tally to channel
plugin.description: BlootReport - type "blootreport help" for the full help.

muclient.script:
require "serialize"
local gHaveWin = pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows") local gHaveCapture = pcall (require, "wrapped_captures")
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours / echo helpers (standard theme) -- ===================================================================== local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets, muted detail local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 plugin name, attention local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 values, commands, buttons
-- bloot tier bracket colours, from Eric's blootx chart local CLR_BG = "#00FF00" -- @G local CLR_BR = "#FF0000" -- @R local CLR_BY = "#FFFF00" -- @Y
-- every colour above as an Aardwolf colour code, for channel output local CODE = { [CLR_TAG] = "@x099", [CLR_NAME] = "@x045", [CLR_MSG] = "@W", [CLR_HI] = "@x048", [CLR_BG] = "@G", [CLR_BR] = "@R", [CLR_BY] = "@Y", }
local TAG = "BlootReport"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function warn (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_NAME, "", msg) end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-28s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
local function helpHead (text) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", text, CLR_TAG, "", "]") end
local gCfg
local function dbg (msg) if gCfg and gCfg.debug then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[blootreport] " .. msg) end end
local function trim (s) return (tostring (s or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "")) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Tiers, lowest first. Order after Mythical follows Eric's blootx chart. -- ===================================================================== local TIERS = { "Polished", "Enhanced", "Burnished", "Shiny", "Vibrant", "Sparkling", "Gleaming", "Shimmering", "Dazzling", "Brilliant", "Radiant", "Wondrous", "Majestic", "Exalted", "Eternal", "Legendary", "Epic", "Mythical", "Fabled", "Divine", "Godly" }
local TIER_BY_LOWER, TIER_RANK = {}, {} for i, t in ipairs (TIERS) do TIER_BY_LOWER [t:lower ()] = t TIER_RANK [t] = i end
-- tiers that start OFF: counted in the tally, never kept, no window local DEFAULT_OFF = { polished = true, enhanced = true, burnished = true }
-- lowest tier the AUTO_BAG shard rule applies to local SHARD_MIN = TIER_RANK ["Shiny"]
-- bracket colour per tier (godly is special, see tierSegs) local TIER_BRACKET = {} for i, t in ipairs (TIERS) do if i <= TIER_RANK ["Brilliant"] then TIER_BRACKET [t] = CLR_BG elseif i <= TIER_RANK ["Eternal"] then TIER_BRACKET [t] = CLR_BR else TIER_BRACKET [t] = CLR_BY end end
-- A tier name as coloured segments { text, colour }, exactly as the chart: -- @G(@Wsparkling@G) @R(@Wradiant@R) @Y(@Wepic@Y) ((@Rgodly@W)) local function tierSegs (tier) local word = tier:lower () if tier == "Godly" then return { { "((", CLR_MSG }, { word, CLR_BR }, { "))", CLR_MSG } } end local b = TIER_BRACKET [tier] or CLR_TAG return { { "(", b }, { word, CLR_MSG }, { ")", b } } end
-- Print { text, colour } segments as one line, [BlootReport] prefix optional local function noteSegs (segs, prefix) local args = {} if prefix then for _, a in ipairs { CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] " } do args [#args + 1] = a end end for _, sg in ipairs (segs) do args [#args + 1] = sg [2] args [#args + 1] = "" args [#args + 1] = sg [1] end ColourNote (unpack (args)) end
local function joinSegs (...) local out = {} for _, list in ipairs { ... } do for _, sg in ipairs (list) do out [#out + 1] = sg end end return out end
-- Items that are always kept and put straight in the bag, no window. -- Keys are normalised names (lower case, colour codes stripped). local AUTO_BAG = { ["a jagged shard of obsidian"] = true, }
-- ===================================================================== -- State -- ===================================================================== local RID_ID = "a5b534a09df80b4093cabbfd" -- Nok3_Report_Identify local RESOLVE_DELAY = 1 -- seconds after the last bloot line local INV_TIMEOUT = 8 -- seconds to wait for the invdata reply local ID_TIMEOUT = 10 -- seconds to wait for the id reply
gCfg = { bag = "lootbag", idchan = "", debug = false, spellid = false, off = {} } for k in pairs (DEFAULT_OFF) do gCfg.off [k] = true end
local function tierOn (tier) return not gCfg.off [tier:lower ()] end local gTally = {} -- [tier] = { got = n, kept = n } local gSeq = 0
-- An item moves through: gPending (waiting for its object id) -- -> gToId (waiting for its stats) -> gShowQ (waiting for the window) -- -> gCurrent (in the window) -> gone local gPending = {} local gToId = {} local gShowQ = {} local gCurrent = nil
local gResolveQueued = false local gInvWaiting = false local gInvRows = {} local gInvToken = 0 local gIdBusy = false
local function loadVar (name, default) local s = GetVariable (name) if not s or s == "" then return default end local f = loadstring ("return " .. s) if not f then return default end local ok, v = pcall (f) if ok and type (v) == "table" then return v end return default end
local function saveAll () SetVariable ("cfg", serialize.save_simple (gCfg)) SetVariable ("tally", serialize.save_simple (gTally)) end
local function tallyFor (tier) if not gTally [tier] then gTally [tier] = { got = 0, kept = 0 } end return gTally [tier] end
-- What to call the item in a game command: its object id when known, -- otherwise the tier word as a keyword (what the old world trigger did). local function ref (it) return it.objid or it.tier:lower () end
-- ===================================================================== -- Tally, channel only -- ===================================================================== local function tallyChannelText () local segs = { { "[", CLR_TAG }, { TAG, CLR_NAME }, { "] ", CLR_TAG } } local totGot, totKept, any = 0, 0, false for _, tier in ipairs (TIERS) do local t = gTally [tier] if t and t.got > 0 then if any then segs [#segs + 1] = { ", ", CLR_TAG } end any = true for _, sg in ipairs (tierSegs (tier)) do segs [#segs + 1] = sg end segs [#segs + 1] = { " Kept ", CLR_TAG } segs [#segs + 1] = { t.kept .. "/" .. t.got, CLR_HI } totGot = totGot + t.got totKept = totKept + t.kept end end if not any then segs [#segs + 1] = { "No bloot tracked yet.", CLR_MSG } else segs [#segs + 1] = { " | ", CLR_TAG } segs [#segs + 1] = { "Total", CLR_MSG } segs [#segs + 1] = { " Kept ", CLR_TAG } segs [#segs + 1] = { totKept .. "/" .. totGot, CLR_HI } end local out, last = {}, nil for _, s in ipairs (segs) do if s [2] ~= last then out [#out + 1] = CODE [s [2]] last = s [2] end out [#out + 1] = (s [1]:gsub ("@", "@@")) -- a literal @ is a colour code end out [#out + 1] = "@w" return table.concat (out) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Stats window: one item at a time -- ===================================================================== local WIN_ID = "BlootReport_win" local WIN_FONT = "Consolas" -- same as MarketWatch's pop-up local WIN_FONT_SIZE = 12 local gWin = nil local gClosing = false local showNext
local gColCache = {} local function col (hex) if not gColCache [hex] then gColCache [hex] = ColourNameToRGB (hex) end return gColCache [hex] end
-- One line of style runs plus its hyperlinks. Positions count visible text. local function winLine (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs (segs) do if s.text ~= "" then styles [#styles + 1] = { text = s.text, textcolour = col (s.colour or CLR_MSG) } if s.code then links [#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #s.text - 1, text = s.code, label = s.tip } end pos = pos + #s.text end end return styles, links end
local function add (segs) local s, l = winLine (segs) gWin:add_text (s, false, l) end
local function button (label, code, tip, colour) return { text = "[ " .. label .. " ]", colour = colour or CLR_HI, code = code, tip = tip } end
function BR_WinDestroy () local w = gWin gWin = nil if w then pcall (function () w:delete (true) end) end pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) pcall (Repaint) end
-- Hide now (safe inside a hotspot callback), destroy once the callback has -- returned, then bring up the next queued item. local function closeWindow () gCurrent = nil gClosing = true pcall (WindowShow, WIN_ID, false) pcall (Repaint) DoAfterSpecial (0.2, "BR_WinDestroy ()", sendto.script) DoAfterSpecial (0.4, "BR_ShowNext ()", sendto.script) end
local function buildWindow () local it = gCurrent if not it then return end if not gHaveWin then warn ("miniwindow library unavailable - " .. it.tier .. " " .. it.name .. " kept.") gCurrent = nil return end
-- a new item always gets a fresh window, since the title is set at creation if gWin then BR_WinDestroy () end
local title = "BlootReport - " .. it.tier:lower () if #gShowQ > 0 then title = title .. " (" .. #gShowQ .. " more waiting)" end
-- v1.6: always pop up in the far upper left corner. movewindow would -- reopen it wherever it was last dragged, so forget that every time and -- let the default (0, 0) apply. for _, k in ipairs { "_windowx", "_windowy", "_windowflags" } do DeleteVariable ("mw_" .. WIN_ID .. k) end
local ok, w = pcall (ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 0, 0, -- left, top: far upper left corner (v1.6) 620, 200, -- default width, height (fit_contents resizes it) title, "center", -- title alignment true, -- is_temporary: title bar close button true, -- resizeable true, -- text_scrollable false, -- text_selectable false, -- text_copyable false, -- url_hyperlinks (ours are explicit) false, -- autowrap off: the id box is fixed width WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- title font, same as MarketWatch WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, -- text font 200, -- max lines nil, -- padding true, -- defer showing until drawn false, nil, "Close (item stays kept)") if not ok or not w then gHaveWin = false warn ("miniwindow unavailable: " .. tostring (w)) gCurrent = nil return end gWin = w -- bold everything, as MarketWatch does: a style's own bold flag only draws -- when the world's show bold option is on, so use TextRect's bold font if gWin.textrect and gWin.textrect.font_bold then gWin.textrect.font = gWin.textrect.font_bold end local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function (self) if prior then prior (self) end gWin = nil -- the close button: dismiss this item and move on if not gClosing and gCurrent then gCurrent = nil DoAfterSpecial (0.3, "BR_ShowNext ()", sendto.script) end end
gWin:clear (false) local head = {} for _, sg in ipairs (tierSegs (it.tier)) do head [#head + 1] = { text = sg [1], colour = sg [2] } end head [#head + 1] = { text = " " .. it.name, colour = CLR_MSG } head [#head + 1] = { text = " " .. (it.objid and ("#" .. it.objid) or "no item number"), colour = CLR_TAG } add (head) add { { text = " " } }
if it.stats and #it.stats > 0 then for _, line in ipairs (it.stats) do if #line > 0 then gWin:add_text (line, false) else add { { text = " " } } end end else add { { text = it.statsProblem or "No stats available.", colour = CLR_NAME } } end
add { { text = " " } } add { button ("KEEP", "BR_Act(\"keep\")", "Put it in " .. gCfg.bag .. " and close"), { text = " " }, button ("UNKEEP", "BR_Act(\"unkeep\")", "Unkeep it and close", CLR_NAME), { text = " " }, button ("REPORT", "BR_Act(\"report\")", gCfg.idchan ~= "" and ("Report it to " .. gCfg.idchan .. " (stays open)") or "No report channel set - see blootreport help"), } if it.note then add { { text = it.note, colour = CLR_TAG } } end
pcall (function () gWin:fit_contents (1000, 600) end) gWin:draw () gWin:show () pcall (Repaint) end
showNext = function () gClosing = false if gCurrent then return end gCurrent = table.remove (gShowQ, 1) if gCurrent then buildWindow () end end
function BR_ShowNext () showNext () end
-- ===================================================================== -- Loot trigger -- ===================================================================== local norm
function BR_LootTrig (name, line, wc) local tier = TIER_BY_LOWER [tostring (wc [1]):lower ()] if not tier then return end local iname = trim (wc [2]) local auto = (AUTO_BAG [norm (iname)] and TIER_RANK [tier] >= SHARD_MIN) or false
-- every tier is counted, on or off local t = tallyFor (tier) t.got = t.got + 1 saveAll ()
if not auto and not tierOn (tier) then dbg ("loot (tier off, counted only): " .. tier .. " / " .. iname) return end
gSeq = gSeq + 1 local it = { seq = gSeq, tier = tier, name = iname, auto = auto, tallied = true } gPending [#gPending + 1] = it dbg ("loot: " .. it.tier .. " / " .. it.name) if not gResolveQueued then gResolveQueued = true DoAfterSpecial (RESOLVE_DELAY, "BR_Resolve ()", sendto.script) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Finding the object id: one silent invdata -- ===================================================================== local function stripCodes (s) s = tostring (s or "") s = s:gsub ("@@", "\1") s = s:gsub ("@[xX]%d%d?%d?", "") s = s:gsub ("@.", "") s = s:gsub ("\1", "@") return s end
norm = function (s) s = stripCodes (s):lower () s = s:gsub ("%b()", " ") s = s:gsub ("[^%w']", " ") s = s:gsub ("%s+", " ") return trim (s) end
local claimed = {} -- object ids already given to an item this session
local startIds
function BR_Resolve () gResolveQueued = false if #gPending == 0 then return end if gInvWaiting then gResolveQueued = true DoAfterSpecial (RESOLVE_DELAY, "BR_Resolve ()", sendto.script) return end gInvWaiting = true gInvRows = {} gInvToken = gInvToken + 1 EnableTrigger ("br_inv_start", true) SendNoEcho ("invdata") DoAfterSpecial (INV_TIMEOUT, "BR_InvTimeout (" .. gInvToken .. ")", sendto.script) dbg ("invdata sent") end
function BR_InvStart () EnableTrigger ("br_inv_start", false) EnableTrigger ("br_inv_line", true) EnableTrigger ("br_inv_end", true) end
function BR_InvLine (name, line, wc) -- id,flags,name,level,type,unique,wearloc,timer - the name may hold commas local f = {} for field in (line .. ","):gmatch ("([^,]*),") do f [#f + 1] = field end if #f < 8 then return end local nm = table.concat (f, ",", 3, #f - 5) gInvRows [#gInvRows + 1] = { id = f [1], raw = stripCodes (nm):lower (), key = norm (nm) } end
local function applyResolution (found) local batch = gPending gPending = {} for _, it in ipairs (batch) do -- oldest first local best if found then local want = norm (it.name) local tierw = "(" .. it.tier:lower () .. ")" local function consider (loose) for _, r in ipairs (gInvRows) do if not claimed [r.id] then local hit = (r.key == want) if loose and not hit and #want >= 4 and #r.key >= 4 then hit = (r.key:find (want, 1, true) or want:find (r.key, 1, true)) and true end if hit then local score = (r.raw:find (tierw, 1, true) and 1e12 or 0) + (tonumber (r.id) or 0) if not best or score > best.score then best = { id = r.id, score = score } end end end end end consider (false) if not best then consider (true) end end if best then it.objid = best.id claimed [best.id] = true dbg ("resolved " .. it.name .. " -> " .. best.id) else dbg ("no invdata match for " .. it.name) it.note = "Could not find its item number - buttons use the keyword '" .. it.tier:lower () .. "'." end SendNoEcho ("keep " .. ref (it)) if it.auto then -- shard exception: straight into the bag, no window Send ("put " .. ref (it) .. " " .. gCfg.bag) if it.tallied then local t = tallyFor (it.tier) t.kept = t.kept + 1 saveAll () end noteSegs (joinSegs (tierSegs (it.tier), { { " " .. it.name .. " kept and put in ", CLR_MSG }, { gCfg.bag, CLR_HI }, { ".", CLR_MSG } }), true) else gToId [#gToId + 1] = it end end startIds () end
function BR_InvEnd () EnableTrigger ("br_inv_line", false) EnableTrigger ("br_inv_end", false) gInvWaiting = false dbg ("invdata rows: " .. #gInvRows) applyResolution (true) end
function BR_InvTimeout (token) if token ~= gInvToken or not gInvWaiting then return end EnableTrigger ("br_inv_start", false) EnableTrigger ("br_inv_line", false) EnableTrigger ("br_inv_end", false) gInvWaiting = false warn ("no invdata reply - keeping by keyword instead.") applyResolution (false) end
-- ===================================================================== -- Stats: silent "id <number>", one item at a time -- ===================================================================== local gIdItem = nil
-- The command that produces the stats box: the id command (needs the -- Identify wish) or, with "blootreport identify on", the identify spell. local function idCommand (it) if gCfg.spellid then return "c identify " .. ref (it) end return "id " .. ref (it) end
local function queueForWindow (it) gShowQ [#gShowQ + 1] = it if not gCurrent and not gClosing then showNext () end end
local function idDone () gIdBusy = false gIdItem = nil startIds () end
-- The capture brackets "id" with echo tags, and combat lines that arrive in -- between get swept up too. Keep only the id box itself: the first dashed -- border line through the last one. With fewer than two borders, keep all. local function styleLineText (line) local t = {} for _, run in ipairs (line or {}) do t [#t + 1] = run.text or "" end return table.concat (t) end
local function isBorder (text) return text:find ("^%s*%+?%-%-%-%-%-+%+?%s*$") ~= nil end
local function trimToIdBox (lines) local first, last for i, line in ipairs (lines) do if isBorder (styleLineText (line)) then first = first or i last = i end end if not first or first == last then return lines end local out = {} for i = first, last do out [#out + 1] = lines [i] end return out end
function BR_IdCaptured (lines) local it = gIdItem if not it then return end lines = lines or {} it.stats = trimToIdBox (lines) if gCfg.spellid then local box = false for _, line in ipairs (lines) do if isBorder (styleLineText (line)) then box = true break end end if not box then it.note = (it.note and (it.note .. " ") or "") .. "No id box came back - the identify spell may have failed (mana, concentration, or you do not know it)." end end dbg ("id captured " .. #it.stats .. " lines") queueForWindow (it) idDone () end
function BR_IdTimeout () local it = gIdItem if not it then return end it.statsProblem = gCfg.spellid and "The identify spell did not answer in time." or "The id command did not answer in time." queueForWindow (it) idDone () end
startIds = function () if gIdBusy then return end local it = table.remove (gToId, 1) if not it then return end if not gHaveCapture then it.statsProblem = "wrapped_captures.lua is not available - cannot read stats silently." queueForWindow (it) return startIds () end gIdBusy = true gIdItem = it local ok, err = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, idCommand (it), true, true, true, BR_IdCaptured, false, BR_IdTimeout, ID_TIMEOUT) if not ok then it.statsProblem = "capture failed: " .. tostring (err) queueForWindow (it) idDone () end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Window buttons -- ===================================================================== local function ridAvailable () return IsPluginInstalled (RID_ID) and GetPluginInfo (RID_ID, 17) end
function BR_Act (action) local it = gCurrent if not it then return end local r = ref (it)
if action == "keep" then Send ("put " .. r .. " " .. gCfg.bag) local t = tallyFor (it.tier) t.kept = t.kept + 1 saveAll () closeWindow ()
elseif action == "unkeep" then Send ("unkeep " .. r) closeWindow ()
elseif action == "report" then if gCfg.idchan == "" then warn ("no report channel set. Use: blootreport idchan <channel>") return end if not it.objid then warn ("no item number for that item, so it cannot be reported.") return end if not ridAvailable () then warn ("the Report Identify (rid) plugin is not loaded, so REPORT cannot send.") return end Execute ("rid " .. it.objid .. " " .. gCfg.idchan) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Commands -- ===================================================================== function BR_Cmd_Help () local v = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 19) or "?" helpHead (TAG .. " v" .. v .. " help") noteSegs (joinSegs ({ { " Tracks bonus loot (bloot) of every tier, from ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Polished"), { { " up to ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Godly"), { { ".", CLR_MSG } })) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Each tier is ", CLR_HI, "", "on", CLR_MSG, "", " or ", CLR_NAME, "", "off", CLR_MSG, "", ". Every tier is counted in the tally, but") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " off tiers are never kept and never pop up a window.") noteSegs (joinSegs ({ { " ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Polished"), { { " ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Enhanced"), { { " and ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Burnished"), { { " start off. See ", CLR_MSG }, { "blootreport tiers", CLR_HI }, { ".", CLR_MSG } })) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") helpHead ("Automatic") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Every item of an ON tier you get from a corpse is kept (", CLR_HI, "", "keep <number>", CLR_MSG, "", "), then") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " its stats (", CLR_HI, "", "id <number>", CLR_MSG, "", ") open in a window. Several drops queue up.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") noteSegs (joinSegs ({ { " Exception: ", CLR_MSG }, { "a jagged shard of obsidian", CLR_HI }, { " at ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Shiny"), { { " or any higher tier", CLR_MSG } })) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " is kept and put straight in your bag, no window, even if") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " that tier is turned off.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") helpHead ("Identify spell") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Stats normally come from the ", CLR_HI, "", "id", CLR_MSG, "", " command, which needs the Identify wish.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " No wish? Turn on the spell instead: ", CLR_HI, "", "blootreport identify on") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Stats are then read from ", CLR_HI, "", "c identify <number>", CLR_MSG, "", ". It costs mana and can") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " fail, and the window will say so. Off by default.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") helpHead ("Window buttons") helpLine ("[ KEEP ]", "put it in your bag, counts as Kept, closes") helpLine ("[ UNKEEP ]", "unkeep it, closes") helpLine ("[ REPORT ]", "send its id to your report channel (uses rid),") helpLine ("", "window stays open") helpLine ("close button", "close without choosing, item stays kept") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") helpHead ("Commands") helpLine ("blootreport <channel>", "send the tally to a channel, e.g.") helpLine ("", "blootreport spo / gt / tell bob") helpLine ("blootreport tiers", "list every tier as on/off (click to flip)") helpLine ("blootreport on <tier>", "keep + window for that tier, e.g. on shiny") helpLine ("blootreport off <tier>", "count only, no keep, no window") helpLine ("", "all works too: blootreport on all") helpLine ("blootreport idchan <chan>", "set the channel REPORT sends to") helpLine ("blootreport idchan off", "clear the report channel") helpLine ("blootreport identify", "toggle the identify spell for stats") helpLine ("", "(no Identify wish). on / off works too") helpLine ("blootreport bag <keyword>", "bag the KEEP button uses") helpLine ("blootreport reset", "zero the tally") helpLine ("blootreport debug", "toggle debug messages") helpLine ("blootreport help", "this help") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Every command also works with ", CLR_HI, "", "blootr", CLR_MSG, "", " in place of ", CLR_HI, "", "blootreport", CLR_MSG, "", ", e.g. ", CLR_HI, "", "blootr spo", CLR_MSG, "", ".") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") helpHead ("Current settings") helpLine ("report channel", gCfg.idchan ~= "" and gCfg.idchan or "none - REPORT will not send") helpLine ("bag", gCfg.bag) helpLine ("stats from", gCfg.spellid and "c identify (spell)" or "id (wish)") local offs = {} for _, tier in ipairs (TIERS) do if not tierOn (tier) then if #offs > 0 then offs [#offs + 1] = { ", ", CLR_TAG } end for _, sg in ipairs (tierSegs (tier)) do offs [#offs + 1] = sg end end end if #offs == 0 then offs = { { "none", CLR_MSG } } end noteSegs (joinSegs ({ { string.format (" %-28s", "tiers off"), CLR_HI } }, offs)) helpLine ("rid plugin", ridAvailable () and "loaded" or "NOT loaded - REPORT needs it") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") noteSegs (joinSegs ({ { " Tally reads like ", CLR_MSG } }, tierSegs ("Sparkling"), { { " Kept ", CLR_TAG }, { "1/5", CLR_HI }, { " = 5 looted, 1 put in the bag with KEEP.", CLR_MSG } })) end
function BR_Cmd_Channel (name, line, wc) local chan = trim (wc [1]) if chan == "" then BR_Cmd_Help () return end -- whatever you typed goes in front, typos and all SendNoEcho (chan .. " " .. tallyChannelText ()) end
function BR_Cmd_Simple (name, line, wc) local what = tostring (wc [1]):lower () if what == "reset" then gTally = {} saveAll () echo ("tally reset.") elseif what == "debug" then gCfg.debug = not gCfg.debug saveAll () echoHi ("debug is now ", gCfg.debug and "ON" or "OFF", ".") end end
function BR_Cmd_Tiers () helpHead (TAG .. " tiers (click ON / OFF to flip)") for _, tier in ipairs (TIERS) do local on = tierOn (tier) local t = gTally [tier] or { got = 0, kept = 0 } ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") local width = 0 for _, sg in ipairs (tierSegs (tier)) do ColourTell (sg [2], "", sg [1]) width = width + #sg [1] end ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 15 - width))) Hyperlink ("blootreport " .. (on and "off " or "on ") .. tier:lower (), on and "[ ON ]" or "[ OFF ]", "Click to turn " .. tier:lower () .. (on and " off" or " on"), on and CLR_HI or CLR_NAME, "", false) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " Kept ", CLR_HI, "", t.kept .. "/" .. t.got) end end
function BR_Cmd_Toggle (name, line, wc) local mode = tostring (wc [1]):lower () local what = trim (wc [2]):lower () local list = {} if what == "all" then for _, tier in ipairs (TIERS) do list [#list + 1] = tier end elseif TIER_BY_LOWER [what] then list [1] = TIER_BY_LOWER [what] else warn ("no bloot tier called '" .. what .. "'. Type blootreport tiers to see them.") return end for _, tier in ipairs (list) do gCfg.off [tier:lower ()] = (mode == "off") or nil end saveAll () local who = (what == "all") and { { "All tiers", CLR_MSG } } or tierSegs (list [1]) noteSegs (joinSegs (who, { { " now ", CLR_MSG }, { mode == "on" and "ON" or "OFF", CLR_HI }, { mode == "on" and " - kept and shown in the window." or " - counted in the tally only.", CLR_MSG } }), true) end
function BR_Cmd_Bag (name, line, wc) local bag = trim (wc [1]) if bag ~= "" then gCfg.bag = bag saveAll () end echoHi ("KEEP puts items in: ", gCfg.bag, "") end
function BR_Cmd_IdChan (name, line, wc) local chan = trim (wc [1]) if chan:lower () == "off" or chan:lower () == "none" then gCfg.idchan = "" saveAll () elseif chan ~= "" then gCfg.idchan = chan saveAll () end if gCfg.idchan == "" then echoHi ("REPORT channel: ", "none", " - REPORT will not send until you set one.") else echoHi ("REPORT channel: ", gCfg.idchan, "") end end
function BR_Cmd_Identify (name, line, wc) local mode = trim (wc [1]):lower () if mode == "on" then gCfg.spellid = true elseif mode == "off" then gCfg.spellid = false else gCfg.spellid = not gCfg.spellid end saveAll () if gCfg.spellid then echoHi ("Stats now come from ", "c identify <number>", " (the spell). Costs mana and can fail.") else echoHi ("Stats now come from ", "id <number>", " (needs the Identify wish).") end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Plugin callbacks -- ===================================================================== function OnPluginInstall () local c = loadVar ("cfg", {}) if type (c.bag) == "string" and c.bag ~= "" then gCfg.bag = c.bag end if type (c.idchan) == "string" then gCfg.idchan = c.idchan end gCfg.debug = c.debug and true or false gCfg.spellid = c.spellid and true or false if type (c.off) == "table" then gCfg.off = {} for k, v in pairs (c.off) do if v then gCfg.off [tostring (k):lower ()] = true end end end gTally = loadVar ("tally", {}) local v = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 19) or "?" ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "v" .. v .. " loaded. Type ", CLR_HI, "", "blootreport help", CLR_MSG, "", " for commands.") end
